annotations.text:
BUILD OBJECTS — UI UPGRADE NORTH STAR

Kept: the #06181D canvas, the Audiowide wordmark, and Encode Sans for figures.
Everything else is new.

Display: Instrument Serif (was 21px Arimo headings — a 2x ramp is why the store read cheap).
UI: Schibsted Grotesk (was Arimo, a Helvetica metric clone with no voice).
Icons: 93 custom glyphs replacing Lucide, one file, same export names.

Start at Home, then The system.

The old header was two rows and 104px because an Audiowide lockup and an 860px search field could not share one row.

Search moves to a Cmd-K overlay. The mark goes 34 -> 44px and the bar drops to 76px.

THE BUILD MACHINE

The house is one SVG with addressable groups (plinth, g0, g1, parapet, mumty, portico, wall). Changing floors animates the group in — it is not a picture of a house, it is the model being costed.

Two ledgers, each against its own entered budget, per the BuildO spec.
